facts.business: Voltas Limited, a Tata Group enterprise, is India's leading provider of cooling solutions and a diversified engineering and project solutions enterprise operating across Unitary Cooling Products (UCP), Electro-Mechanical Projects and Services (EMPS), and Engineering Products and Services (EPS).

guidance_or_targets.statement: Manufacturing investments at Chennai and Pantnagar are delivering improved capacity utilisation relative to the previous year, and continued investment in factory automation, warehouse rationalisation, and integrated inventory planning is expected to yield further operational benefits.
Benefits of channel infrastructure, and technology are expected to accrue progressively through 2026-27 and beyond.

auditor.name: S R B C & CO LLP

key_risks: geopolitical disruptions affecting international project execution
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with the related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the Notes to the financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
